messages:
maria: Customer reports intermittent "Invalid JSON response" when using response_format=structured&schema=v2. Happened ~1-2% of calls. Customer can't change client quickly. Attached repro curl from them:

```
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?response_format=structured&schema=v2" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-***' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json; charset=UTF-16, text/html' \
  -H 'X-Client-Version: acme-1.3.0' \
  -d '{"prompt":"..."}'
```

maria: They see 502 + HTML body sometimes; our SDK then fails parsing with a JSON error.

sam: Can you paste gateway logs or the small trace? Need to know what content-type made it back to the SDK.

maria: Log excerpt from edge & parser: 

```
edge: 2026-03-16T14:12:01Z request_id=abc123 headers={"Accept":"application/json; charset=UTF-16, text/html", "X-Client-Version":"acme-1.3.0"}
upstream: 502 returned body (truncated) content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8
parser: structured-mode(strict): rejecting non-json content -> Invalid JSON: unexpected token '<' at position 0
```

chris: Two things look suspect: the Accept header includes a charset param (UTF-16) and ordering that may make the origin choose text/html. Also our strict enforcement currently validates charset=="utf-8" on application/json; that will reject "application/json; charset=UTF-16" even if body is valid JSON.

maria: Customer says they cannot change client immediately. Any server-side short-term mitigation?

sam: Quick workaround: server can ignore charset param when deciding JSON vs non-JSON. I'll prototype treating any media-type whose type/subtype is application/json as JSON regardless of charset. Also we can add a temporary relax flag on the route: response_accept_loose=true.

chris: I'll open ENGAPI-2345 to change the content-type decision layer:
- treat "application/json" with any charset as JSON
- when body is declared application/json with non-utf8 charset, attempt to transcode or fall back to byte-scan for JSON signature before strict parse
- add telemetry for Accept header charsets and X-Client-Version combos

maria: For the customer-facing workaround, ask them to remove the charset from Accept or set `-H 'Accept: application/json'`. Also suggest retry with response_format=loose_structured (temporary compatibility mode).

billing-bot: Customer did multiple retries and token usage spiked; if the root cause is on our side we should consider a small credit for retry attempts. Tagging billing review.

eng-api-bot: Escalation created INC-20260316-42 -> assigned to eng-api team, priority P2, related ticket ENGAPI-2345.

maria: Test plan: run synthetic traffic with permutations: Accept variants (with/without charset), orderings, and X-Client-Version header. Measure HTML fallback rate and error surface. I'll attach repro script once validated.

sam: Good. Assigning to @chris for code change and @maria to coordinate with the customer. :thumbsup:
